summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for monitored administration of abatacept due to a prior anaphylactoid reaction. He was premedicated with high-dose prednisone, methylprednisolone, diphenhydramine, and famotidine. During the infusion, he developed hand and arm swelling with erythema, followed by chest tightness, both of which responded to treatment with IV Benadryl and Atrovent nebulizer. He remained stable for 24 hours post-infusion and was discharged home in stable condition. His diabetes management was temporarily adjusted with insulin during the stay, and antihypertensives were held during monitoring. All home medications were resumed at discharge with minor dosage adjustments.
problems: Diabetes with neurological manifestations, type II or unspecified type, not stated as uncontrolled
